name: Radio WBF
description: RadioWBF is WeAreBornFree Community Radio, a collective radio practice from Neukölln, Berlin. Live channels, community shows, DJ sets, talk shows and an open archive.
motto: An open invitation to speak and to truly listen

home.posterText: We invite musicians, artists, activists, community organisers and cultural workers to make their own monthly programme in our shared broadcast space. Come and be heard, come and listen, come and make space for others.

player.popoutButton: Open the player in its own window

pagesIntro.archive: Listen back to shows made in Neukölln and beyond. Press play and keep browsing, the sound follows you.
pagesIntro.schedule: This week on Channel 1, read live from the studio calendar. All times are Berlin time.
pagesIntro.chat: Join the conversation while you listen. Press Live at the top, the radio keeps going while you chat.

footer.text1: Community radio is the voice of a neighbourhood, a space where everyday voices matter. Not glossy productions, not commercial agendas, but connection: local songs, conversations on migrant rights, stories about life, shaped on the airwaves together.
footer.text2: That is what we make here in Neukölln, every day. An open invitation to speak and to truly listen.

support.title: Become a supporter
support.text: RadioWBF is run by volunteers, without ads and without sponsors. A small monthly contribution keeps the studio open, the streams running and the doors wide for new voices.
